review.finding: Comment says 'Capture the REAL retry argv' but retry_cmd = build_command(unit, workers) omits --basetemp (and --junit-xml) the retry actually ran with; a human running it on Windows gets pytest's default deep basetemp and can hit the MAX_PATH FileNotFoundError.
review.suggestion: Soften the comment ('minus run-local temp/report paths') or add a short stable basetemp in reproduce_command.

review.finding: assert basetemp != unit_tmp is implied by basetemp.parent == unit_tmp; fake returns SimpleNamespace while sibling tests build suite_process.ProcessResult.
review.suggestion: Drop the redundant assert; build the fake with ProcessResult.

review.finding: 'do not accept the retry' overstates what is enforced; the runner still passes RETRY-GREEN automatically.
review.suggestion: Reword as an operator judgement: treat as a regression to fix, not an ordinary race.

probe_answers.1_xdist_and_wipe: Safe: xdist worker basetemp = controller basetemp / popen-gwN and honours --basetemp; only <unit tmp>/t is wiped, attempt.log and r.xml sit beside it; COVERAGE_FILE unaffected; retry uses its own tmp dir.
probe_answers.4_tests_fail_without_fix: Yes: TypeError on unknown basetemp kwarg / ValueError on missing --basetemp.
